803e3ceffc:
The long-awaited time has come...
to prove that our many fallen heroes did not die in vain.
531c705aaa:
To raise the ideals of Zeon once more!
To accomplish Stardust!
Solomon, I have returned...!
fca0c6b61f:
Unit 2 is attacking the fleet...?
Damn it, am I going to be useless again!?
fc6b92dee6:
Thank you...
I'll master it, whatever the machine.
Ensign Uraki, Stamen, charging in!
ccaa2dd081:
U.C. 0083. The Zeon remnants of the Delaz Fleet
launched Operation Stardust.
0bc2e5c71d:
Anavel Gato, the core of the Delaz Fleet, began by
stealing the Gundam GP02, secretly developed by the
Federation, and fired a nuke at the Federation fleet.
bd5a50aa80:
The Federation was thrown into chaos...
But the Delaz Fleet's offensive
did not stop there.
62bcd81e4e:
They meant to drop the space colony Island Ease
on the North American breadbasket, striking a blow
at the people living on Earth.
25c010cfc2:
Seeing Unit 2 attacking the fleet, Kou was frustrated
by his own weakness and the situation.
19f470f2af:
When Unit 2 was stolen, Kou had fought Gato,
but Gato had brushed him aside
like twisting a baby's arm.
f457d2b07f:
But the women of Anaheim, even at their own sacrifice,
entrusted Kou with a new machine:
the Gundam GP03S Stamen.
77ee179a29: Only by seeing this through will others follow after us.
a96f971aa5:
If you hadn't served the rotten Federation,
you wouldn't have had to suffer!
971be24df7:
I won't be satisfied until I strike them!
Solar System, fire!
193436af25: Gato... left without finishing me off...?
7b03c59aed: To pass on our true battle to future generations!
48f0746c45:
Though Gato lost the Gundam GP02 in his battle with
Kou, he returned to the battlefield in a giant
mobile armor.
9385c983e0:
He destroyed the Federation's Solar System, meant to
stop the colony drop, and watched the colony enter
its course to fall on Earth.
57124d181a:
Its goal achieved, the Delaz Fleet withdrew, joining
the Axis fleet that had come for them.
But Gato was not among the withdrawing fleet.
ff478a2c13:
Gato stayed behind alone to settle things with Kou.
But their fight was cut off by the light of the Solar
System fired by acting fleet commander Bask Om.
41ea1ff7ce:
Kou passed out in the blinding light.
When he awoke, Gato was already gone.
28ef4a6e73:
With his machine damaged both by the fight with Kou
and by the Solar System, Gato's strength gave out
before he could reach the Axis fleet.
83bb91d113:
A soldier who lived for loyalty was scattered in space.
Only Kou knows the memory of Stardust...
